iut_type: End Product using pre-tested components (IDEAL company)
customer_question: Since our product's components already passed the required tests previously, do we still need to submit a physical test sample for this registration?
question_variants: Is a test sample submission required if the relevant components already have passing test results?
actual_issue: The customer wanted to confirm whether they could skip submitting a physical test sample for the current registration, given that the relevant Bluetooth components had already undergone and passed the required testing previously.
plain_english_explanation: Because the components in question already have passing test results from prior testing, no new test sample submission is required for this registration — the existing test results can be relied upon.
consultant_answer: No additional test sample submission is required, since the relevant components already have passing test results from previous testing.
decision_logic: Test sample submission is only required where valid, applicable passing test results for the relevant components/features do not already exist; pre-existing passing results can be reused to satisfy this requirement.
final_recommendation: When a customer's components have prior passing test results, confirm exemption from new sample submission explicitly so they don't unnecessarily prepare or ship a physical sample.
risk_if_done_wrong: Requiring a redundant test sample submission despite existing valid passing results would create unnecessary cost and delay for the customer.
search_aliases: do I need to submit test sample if already passed
